rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a score or rating of someone’s ability or performance.

example.english: The rating for this film is very high.
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 ping4 fan1 hou2 gou1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a financial credit rating, such as a person’s or company’s creditworthiness.

example.english: This company’s credit rating was recently downgraded.
example.traditional: 呢間公司嘅信貸評級最近被調低。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 seon3 taai3 ping4 kap1 zeoi3 gan6 bei6 tiu4 dai1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the audience rating of a television programme.

example.english: This programme’s rating is higher than last year’s.
example.traditional: 呢個節目嘅收視率高過上年。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 ge3 sau1 si6 leot6 gou1 gwo3 soeng6 nin4
